provenance.instrument: West Vincent Township Zoning Ordinance of 2010, Chapter 390 Zoning, as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: 390-1: 'West Vincent Township Zoning Ordinance of 2010.' eCode360 header: legislation through 01-05-2026. New Laws (read 2026-11-13) list Ord. No. 227 'Data Center Land Use' (2026-06-15) and non-zoning items (Ord. Nos. 225, 226, 228 to 230). No ADU amendment is pending there.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 header on 2026-11-13: 'legislation through 01-05-2026'. New Laws lists items to 2026-09-21, none an ADU change.
checks: Accessory dwelling units are a permitted accessory use in RC, R-3, R-2, RM and KV, 'subject to the provisions of § 390-144'. In BV they are a conditional use (Board of Supervisors). Not listed in MHP, PC/LI, LVCC, M or the VCR overlay use list (390-16D(5), 390-22D(5), 390-28D(5), 390-33C(5), 390-39C(5), 390-48B(4))

Which forms depend on lot size. Any parcel: an accessory apartment inside the house (at most 25% of its habitable floor area) and an apartment in an existing barn. Parcels of five acres or less: a unit only in a freestanding building that existed when the 2010 ordinance was adopted, no new freestanding building. Parcels over five acres: a new freestanding building is allowed (390-144E(9) to (11))
One ADU on a lot under 25 acres, two on 25 acres or more. Habitable floor area at most 1,800 sq ft (390-144E(2), (3))
A detached unit: 10 ft from the house, the owner lives in one of the units, and it shares the house's driveway unless the Board decides otherwise (390-144E(8))

Freestanding unit: side or rear yard only, at most 1,000 sq ft of impervious coverage (1,600 sq ft with an attached garage), 25 ft or two stories, whichever is less. In an existing building the height may not be raised (390-144E(10), (11))

Front yard: an ADU may stand in the front yard only in a building that existed at enactment, or 350 ft back from the front line. Otherwise in a side yard at least 15 ft behind the front of the house, or in the rear yard (390-144A(4))
Accessory buildings over 500 sq ft take the principal side and rear setbacks (390-144B)
Sewage and water need Chester County Health Department approval before a building permit (390-144E(5))

Parking: the parking rules apply to each ADU, and a dwelling needs three spaces. A unit inside the house or in an existing building must use existing parking areas (390-144E(4), E(9)(a)[4], E(10)(a)[3], 390-135)
Lots in RC, R-3 and R-2 have no fixed minimum size. Each district sets density by subdivision 'tier'. For an existing lot the Tier IV setbacks apply (390-18C, 390-206B(2))

Historic resources (Class I, II or III): an ADU is allowed 'irrespective of any minimum lot size, maximum impervious coverage or maximum habitable floor area'. The conversion may get a lower lot area by conditional use after Historical Commission review (390-144E(9)(c), 390-192B). 390-144E(9)(c) cites 390-191, which is the archaeological section. 390-192 is the historic reuse section. Ask the zoning officer
A freestanding ADU may be sold as a condominium after subdivision and land development approval (390-144E(10)(a)[4], E(11)(a)[4])
provenance.notes: Zoning office: West Vincent Township (westvincenttwp.org). Read on eCode360 in a browser, one section print view at a time, and the chapter print view searched in the page. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, ECHO, elder cottage, caretaker, guest house, carriage house, tenant house, second dwelling, tiny house. Chester County Planning Commission eTool 14 (cross-check only) lists West Vincent as by right in most residential districts with old section 2201(E). It matches the current 390-144. VCR (Village Center Residential Overlay) applies only after the Route 100 bypass is built or guaranteed (390-65). Its dimensional rules mention 'Minimum additional land per accessory dwelling unit (maximum of two units): 4,000 square feet' (390-69A(3)), but its use list (390-68) does not list ADUs.

term.note: 390-8: 'ACCESSORY DWELLING A dwelling whose use is secondary to that of the principal dwelling or building on the same lot, including but not limited to accessory apartment, tenant house or carriage house.' 'ACCESSORY APARTMENT A self-contained accessory dwelling unit located entirely within an existing single-family dwelling'.

status.note: Listed as a permitted accessory use in RC, R-3, R-2, RM and KV: 'Accessory dwelling units, subject to the provisions of § 390-144.' Conditional use in BV (390-48B(4)). Not listed in other districts. A detached unit needs the owner to live on the lot (390-144E(8)(b)).

path.note: A permitted accessory use. Zoning and building permit. Sewage and water approval from the Chester County Health Department first (390-144E(5)).

fallback_path.note: A unit that fails 390-144 has no listed path. A use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board. No general unlisted-use section in Chapter 390 (similar-use special exception only in PC/LI and VCR).

value.note: 'Accessory dwelling unit, subject to the provisions contained herein and in § 390-144' is a conditional use in BV (Board of Supervisors, 390-219).

value.name: Tenant house
value.conditions: Only on an active agricultural operation with 50 or more contiguous acres. One tenant house per 25 acres, for farm workers or family members of the owner. At most 2,500 sq ft of impervious coverage each.
value.note: The code calls a tenant house an accessory dwelling type (390-8, 390-144E).

value.name: More apartments in an existing barn
value.conditions: Up to four more apartments in a barn that existed when the ordinance was adopted. Barn impervious coverage may not grow by more than 1,000 sq ft.

value.name: Conversion of a single-family dwelling
value.conditions: Lot area, yard and building area for each unit. No exterior alteration except for safety. Units of 500 to 900 sq ft at least by bedrooms. Parking for each unit. Only for a dwelling with 'relatively little economic usefulness as a single-family dwelling'. The Zoning Hearing Board sets the number of families.
value.note: 40,000 sq ft reads 390-147B (district lot area for each unit) with the RM 20,000 sq ft lot (390-34).

value.name: Conversion of a single-family dwelling
value.conditions: Same 390-147 standards. KV lot area 20,000 sq ft for each unit. BV 30,000 sq ft of adjusted tract area for each use.
value.note: 40,000 sq ft is the KV figure (20,000 for each unit). BV would need about 60,000 sq ft (390-49A).

value.name: Two-family dwelling
value.conditions: Two-family building types by conditional use. 15,000 sq ft of lot for each unit.

zoning_districts.note: By right in RC, R-3, R-2, RM, KV. Conditional use in BV. Not listed in MHP, PC/LI, LVCC, M or the VCR overlay.

building_types.note: 'Only one accessory apartment shall be permitted per single-family dwelling.' Semidetached dwellings are permitted in RM and KV. Whether a twin may have an ADU is not settled.

existing_structure_only.note: On parcels over five acres a new freestanding building may hold an ADU. On five acres or less only a building that existed at adoption (390-144E(10)(b)). See gates.

historic_bypass.note: Historic resources use the same by-right path with relief from lot size, coverage and floor area. Not a different path. See checks.

value.condition: A new freestanding building for an ADU only on a parcel of more than five acres. On five acres or less, 'Accessory dwellings shall not be permitted in freestanding buildings not in existence as of the date of the adoption of this chapter'.
On a parcel of five acres or less, a unit in a freestanding building only if the building existed when the 2010 ordinance was adopted, and its height may not be raised.
For a detached unit 'The owner(s) of the parcel must reside in one of the dwelling units on the parcel.'
Detached unit 10 ft from the house and on the same driveway unless the Board allows another. Designed 'to harmonize with vernacular rural buildings'. Separate cooking and lavatory facilities.
Freestanding unit: impervious coverage at most 1,000 sq ft (1,600 sq ft with an attached garage). Side or rear yard only.
Accessory apartment inside the house: its own entrance, at most 25% of the house's habitable floor area, parking in existing facilities.
Sewage disposal and water connections approved by the Chester County Health Department before a building permit.
One ADU on a lot under 25 acres, two on 25 acres or more. In a Tier I subdivision, one ADU for each approved house lot.
RC: all customary residential accessory structures together may cover at most 5% of the gross lot area, unless the Zoning Hearing Board grants a special exception. Ask whether an ADU building counts.

types_allowed.note: Inside the house (accessory apartment), an existing barn or freestanding building, a new freestanding building over five acres, and a unit on the second floor of a garage (E(11)(a)[2]). An addition attached to the house is not named in 390-144. Left out. Ask the zoning officer.

max_sqft.note: 'Unless otherwise specified in this chapter, the habitable floor area of the accessory dwelling units shall not exceed 1,800 square feet.'

max_share_internal.note: Accessory apartment within the house: 'The maximum size shall not exceed 25% of the total habitable floor area of the principal dwelling.'

max_share_of_house.note: No share cap for a unit in a freestanding building.

max_height_ft.note: 'Units shall have a maximum height of 25 feet or two-story equivalent (whichever is lesser), unless the unit is placed in an existing building (in which case, the height of the existing building may not be increased).' District accessory height is also 25 ft.

internal_uses_district_height.note: A unit inside the house takes the 35 ft dwelling height.

setback_front_ft.note: Not in the front yard unless in an existing building or 350 ft back from the front line. Otherwise in a side yard 15 ft behind the house front, or the rear yard.

front_yard_barred.note: 'Otherwise, accessory dwelling units must be located in the side yards, at least 15 feet behind the front facade of the primary dwelling unit, or located in the rear yard.' Exceptions: an existing building, or 350 ft from the front line.

setback_side_ft.note: Over 500 sq ft: principal side setbacks. Under 500 sq ft: 5 ft (R-2 Tier I and II 10 ft). See districts.

setback_rear_ft.note: Over 500 sq ft: principal rear setbacks. Under 500 sq ft: 10 ft (Tier I, II) or 5 ft (Tier III, IV). See districts.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: 'Side- and rear-yard setbacks for accessory buildings and structures larger than 500 square feet shall be the same as those for principal buildings.' Read as binding a detached ADU, since most exceed 500 sq ft.

separation_ft.note: 'Accessory dwelling units shall be set back a minimum of 10 feet from the principal dwelling.'

owner_occupancy.note: Only for a detached unit: the owner lives in one of the units. See gates.

family_only.note: No family rule for an ADU. Tenant houses are for farm workers or the owner's family (390-144E(12)).

max_adus.note: One on a lot under 25 acres, two on 25 acres or more. An apartment in the house and a barn conversion are allowed on any size parcel.

sale_apart_allowed.note: A freestanding ADU 'may be owned in a condominium form of ownership ... and sold as a condominium to a third party', after subdivision and land development approval.

short_term_rental_banned.note: No short-term rental rule for an ADU. Bed-and-breakfast rules limit non-host rentals to 15 days at a time and 60 nights a year.

spaces_required.note: 'The off-street parking requirements of this chapter shall apply to each accessory dwelling unit.' 390-135: 'Dwelling: three parking spaces for each dwelling unit.'

reading.value: Each ADU takes the dwelling rate, three spaces, so six with the house. A unit in the house or in an existing building must use existing parking areas. Ask the zoning officer.

new_connection_required.note: Sewage and water connections approved by the Chester County Health Department. No rule on a separate connection.

min_lot_sqft.note: No minimum lot area by tier. Density one unit per 10 acres (Tier I) to one per 120,000 sq ft (Tier IV). The 120,000 sq ft figure sets nonconforming status (390-18C). Not stored as a lot minimum.

setback_front_ft.note: Tier IV default: 50 ft from existing Township roads, 20 ft from new streets.

min_lot_sqft.note: No minimum lot area by tier. Tier IV density one unit per 120,000 sq ft. Not stored as a lot minimum.

setback_front_ft.note: Tier IV: 50 ft from existing roads, 15 ft from new streets.

min_lot_sqft.note: No minimum lot area by tier. Tier IV density one unit per 100,000 sq ft. Not stored as a lot minimum.
'Every lot containing a single-family dwelling ... not less than 20,000 square feet'.

setback_side_ft.note: Two side yards, 35 ft together, neither under 15 ft.

principal_max_height_ft.note: Dwelling height 35 ft as in the other residential districts. Accessory 25 ft.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'A minimum adjusted tract area of 30,000 square feet shall be provided for a single use, with an additional 30,000 square feet ... for each additional use.' Whether an ADU counts as an additional use is not settled.
